item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] After taking a bullet for deputies, Polk County K-9 'Ace' survives surgery
item.description: A Polk County Sheriff's Office K-9 is expected to recover after being shot while helping deputies arrest a wanted fugitive, though the injuries forced surgeons to amputate one of his front legs.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Autism advocate urges swim lessons after 5-year-old with autism drowns in Hillsborough pond
item.description: An autism advocate urges swim lessons after a 5-year-old boy with autism drowned Friday in a Hillsborough County retention pond.
